description: This file contains internal cryptographic mode function declarations and type definitions for AES, GCM, POLYVAL, and other cipher modes, primarily used within the OpenSSL/boringssl cryptography library.

methods.name: CRYPTO_ctr128_encrypt
methods.description: Encrypts or decrypts data in CTR mode using a block cipher.

methods.name: CRYPTO_gcm128_init_key
methods.description: Initializes GCM key structure with AES key and block function.

methods.name: CRYPTO_gcm128_setiv
methods.description: Sets the IV (nonce) for GCM context.

methods.name: CRYPTO_gcm128_encrypt_ctr32
methods.description: Encrypts data in CTR mode with 32-bit counter.

methods.name: CRYPTO_gcm128_decrypt_ctr32
methods.description: Decrypts data in CTR mode with 32-bit counter.

methods.name: CRYPTO_gcm128_finish
methods.description: Finalizes GCM authentication and verifies tag.

methods.name: CRYPTO_gcm128_tag
methods.description: Calculates and outputs GCM authentication tag.

methods.name: CRYPTO_POLYVAL_update_blocks
methods.description: Updates POLYVAL accumulator with input blocks.

methods.name: CRYPTO_POLYVAL_finish
methods.description: Outputs the final POLYVAL accumulator value.
